selection: Frozen winners from omit50-challenge-v1.json; no post-selection tuning.
sensitivity: Central differences at ±0.1% of each bounded parameter span, at fixed image plane and with original hard constraints. Local derivatives are not unique Seidel aberration contributions or tolerancing certification; invalid probes have null derivative. Existing DLS Jacobians guide search; these diagnostics explain the selected solutions.
accounting: Post-selection analysis is separate from each 10000-evaluation optimization budget; 1 dense recheck + 1 holdout + 2 probes per variable + 4 physical configurations per prescription.
